name.en: HGUC 1/144 Zaku I black triple star specification

relatedItems.en: HG 1/144 Rick Dom Gaia machine/Ortega machine (GQ)

ja: ルウム戦役で活躍し「黒い三連星」の名を轟かせた黒いザクIがHGUCでキット化。黒い三連星仕様の機体色を成形色で再現。腰が回転し、上半身を前屈させることでショルダータックルを再現可能。ヒジ部は新採用の２重関節により可動範囲が拡大。ザクバズーカ、肩部バズーカラック、105mmザクマシンガン、ヒートホーク、シュツルムファウスト、ナックルシールドが付属。黒い三連星の専用マーキングシールが付属。
en: The black Zaku I, which played an active role in the Battle of Loum and was known as the "Black Tri-Star", has been made into a kit by HGUC. The black triple star specification aircraft color is reproduced with molding color. You can recreate a shoulder tackle by rotating your hips and bending your upper body forward. The elbow has a newly adopted double joint that expands the range of motion. Includes Zaku Bazooka, Shoulder Bazooka Rack, 105mm Zaku Machine Gun, Heat Hawk, Sturmfaust, and Knuckle Seal. Comes with a special marking seal of black triple stars.
